title: Madhubani Painting of Kohbar Ghar
materials: Natural mineral pigments on handmade paper
description: The Kohbar motif depicts traditional nuptial chamber symbolism with lotus and bamboo groves symbolizing fertility and longevity within the Mithila cultural sphere of North Bihar. Documented meticulously with oral provenance.
practitioner_statement: Art handed down mother to daughter through wedding bridal murals
narrative_oral: Sacred song recited during painting of Kohbar
provenance_history: Acquired from artisan family in Ranti village 1972

title: Chola Bronze Nataraja Temple Deity
description: Magnificent sacred bronze representation of Shiva as Nataraja performing the Ananda Tandava dance of cosmic bliss within an aureole of flames. Extensively documented masterwork with inscriptions on base.
practitioner_statement: Consecrated under imperial Chola royal patronage
narrative_oral: Temple ritual invocation recited during Brahmotsavam procession
provenance_history: Discovered in temple hoard at Tiruvalangadu 1920
